'''Elwin''' was a [[Da'shain Aiel]] boy, one of the five children of [[Adan]] and [[Siedre]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Elwin|comp}}

== History ==
Elwin died of hunger at age ten during the Aiel travels after the [[Breaking of the World|Breaking]] when they hardly had enough food and water to survive and they were constantly attacked by people taking their food and women. {{ref/book|4|26}}

==Errata==
He is listed as [[Jenn Aiel]] in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], but the term Jenn did not exist until decades after his death. He should be Da'shain Aiel.{{ref||comp}}
